name: image-peek
description: See the images you paste: thumbnails above the prompt while you type, previews on sent messages (on hover in fullscreen), a pane, and /peek N for a big view.

graphics.title: How to draw images
graphics.description: auto picks by terminal. file: kitty/Ghostty read the PNG from disk. bytes: send PNG bytes (iTerm2, tmux). blocks: colored half-block cells, works in any terminal. off: labels only.

autoOpenPane.title: Open the pane when you paste an image
autoOpenPane.description: Opens the Images pane beside the chat (fullscreen layout only) the first time an image lands in the prompt. The band above the prompt shows it either way.
